author: CodexOrig5
scope: Read-only installed Microsoft XAML package metadata/IL and installed default VS profile review; no IDE launch, GUI changes, product source edits, or settings changes.

finding.meaning: When editing an XAML element's start or end tag name, automatically rename the matching paired tag to keep the element tags aligned.
finding.confidence: High for installed VS 2017 and 2019 package getter fallback; high for installed VS 2019 default field and VS 2022 default profiles / getter fallback.

evidence.metadata: MS.Internal.XamlSettings.get_AutoUpdateTags reads Microsoft.VisualStudio.TextEditor.Xaml.Miscellaneous.AutoUpdateTags and supplies bool true to GetValueOrDefault when unset.
Getter fallback true and default constant AutoUpdateTags=true.

XamlMiscPage getter returns true when settings service is unavailable; OnBufferChanged gates ProcessBufferChange with AutoUpdateTags; ProcessBufferChange calls RenameElementTags for matched start/end tag-name edits.

visual_studio_2017_general_profile: AutoUpdateTags property row absent; package getter fallback confirms default true, so absence is not evidence of false.
official_doc_limit: Microsoft Learn results do not document AutoUpdateTags itself; the semantic finding comes from the installed vendor package metadata/IL. No unsupported public-contract claim is made.

xaml_designer_zoom_setting_followup.meaning: Default zoom for the XAML designer; value 1 is FitAll.
xaml_designer_zoom_setting_followup.vs2019: Default field and GetValueOrDefault fallback are 1.
xaml_designer_zoom_setting_followup.vs2022: Default field is 1; installed profiles serialize 1.
xaml_designer_zoom_setting_followup.vs2017: No matching setting in installed XAML package/default profiles.
xaml_designer_zoom_setting_followup.interpretation: A newly exported row with value 1 matches the package default; raw addition alone does not establish a user-visible setting change.

vs2017_c9_additional_xaml_defaults.interpretation: New True rows equal the package fallback when absent; actual per-user change is decided only from isolated store before/after values.
